feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 June 2026 11:09am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 15 June 2026 at 11:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure gradually displaced from the west by an approaching frontal zone.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the south to start, decreasing 3 or 4 later this afternoon, veering south or southwest 3 to 5 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then areas of mist developing overnight with isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor overnight and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, increasing force 5 in central areas for a time.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain as well as areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, falling very poor in fog patches.
